question: The portion of agricultural product that is sold by farmers in market is popularly known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**marketed surplus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The portion of agricultural product that is sold by farmers in the market is popularly known as **marketed surplus**.
 
• **Marketed surplus** refers to the quantity of produce that is sold off by the farmers after meeting their own consumption needs.
 
• This surplus is crucial as it forms the basis of the agricultural supply in the market and affects the overall food security and economy.
 
• Understanding marketed surplus helps in planning and policy-making for agricultural marketing, pricing, and storage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Marketed surplus is different from **marketable surplus**, which is the total quantity of produce that can be sold in the market after accounting for storage, wastage, and other losses.
 
• The concept of marketed surplus is significant for understanding the market dynamics and the income of farmers.
 
• Policies to improve the marketed surplus can include better storage facilities, efficient transportation, and fair pricing mechanisms.
 
• Accurate data on marketed surplus helps in framing agricultural policies and ensuring that farmers get a fair price for their produce.
